column1: # "Do not trap me inside your dictionary."
# Two different promises, and they are not the same one:
#   * the literal input is ALWAYS somewhere on the first page, whatever else we
#     found, so it is one keystroke away (and Enter commits it regardless);
#   * when nothing we found is trustworthy, the literal input LEADS, so the
#     space bar cannot turn an identifier into a random English word.
# nothing plausible exists -> the literal leads
# a confident correction exists -> it leads, but the literal stays on page one
# "zsh" really is one neighbouring key away from "ssh"; the correction winning
# is right, and the literal still sits on the first page.
# a word that is already correct is its own first candidate
